Par défaut, Mana Orbit affiche le <b>pri: By default, Mana Orbit shows the Cardmarket trend price, updated every day: free and with no account, ideal for estimates. CardTrader gives real seller offers (condition, language, shipping) and fills your cart, with your CardTrader token (Settings). You choose in “New cart” › Criteria › Price, when CardTrader is available.
Comment ajouter mes cartes ?: How do I add my cards?
Touche <b>Ma collection</b> sur l'accuei: Tap My collection on the home screen, then the buttons at the top: Import a CSV file (ManaBox, Moxfield, Dragon Shield, Archidekt, Deckbox…) or a “3 Sol Ring” list; Scan: the camera reads the card name, in French or English; + to look up a card by name.
Comment est calculée la valeur de ma col: How is my collection's value calculated?
Pour chaque carte, le <b>prix tendance C: For each card, the Cardmarket trend price (as read by Scryfall) times your copies. It's an estimate: set, condition and foil don't change it, and a card without a price isn't counted. Prices are refreshed at most once a day; the chart keeps one reading per day. In “New cart”, the Cardmarket price is a “from” price: the trend of the cheapest printing.
Quels decks EDHREC puis-je monter ?: Which EDHREC decks can I build?
Ma collection › <b>Decks</b> (ou la tuil: My collection › Decks (or the “Deck to build” tile) compares your collection with the decks of the most played commanders: EDHREC average deck and recent Archidekt decks (Budget, Premium, cEDH). You see the share you already own, the cards to buy and their price. Built a deck? Mark it as “Built deck”: its cards are reserved for it. You need an account (Google, or an email address verified through the link you receive).
À quoi sert la liste d'échange ?: What is the trade list for?
Ma collection › <b>Échange</b> réunit te: My collection › Trade gathers your duplicates (copies your decks don't use, beyond what you keep) and the cards you're looking for (those missing from your decks, plus your wishes). With an account, create a public link: your friends see your list, always up to date, without being able to change anything.
Non : sans compte, tout reste sur cet ap: No: without an account, everything stays on this device. An account (email or Google) backs up your collection, your decks, the value history and your trade list, and brings them to all your devices. Your CardTrader token stays on the device.
Réglages › <b>Gérer les notifications</b: Settings › Manage notifications: “Search finished” tells you when a CardTrader search ends after you've left the app; price alerts flag a sharp drop on a card missing from your decks or on a card you follow (the server checks every 6 hours). In your collection, cards whose price moved a lot are flagged too.
Comment effacer mes données ?: How do I erase my data?
Réglages › Confidentialité › <b>Effacer: Settings › Privacy › Erase this device's data: collection, decks, settings and caches. With an account, Account › Delete my account also erases everything online (decks, collection, history, trade list, shared links). It can't be undone.
